::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal"}
## About the Course Project
For the project, your team must **model, simulate, and build** the system and implement **closed-loop control**.

[📂 View Project Ideas & Build Resources](project-ideas.qmd){.btn .btn-primary .btn-sm}
:::

## Project Assessment and Timeline

This is a **5-week project** with **3 graded milestones**.

| Component | Weight | Due Date | Submission |
|---|:---:|:---:|:---:|
| **Milestone 1** — Project definition & modeling | 10% | April 4 | [Link](https://forms.office.com/Pages/ResponsePage.aspx?id=iLC0KX3SKUG5-YY3tZ6ks0CgaHBEKShAjtM5JlnmP3pURFRMVklWMVVEM0FDUEpFQ1g3RUtUQkQ1US4u){.btn .btn-sm .btn-outline-primary}|
| **Milestone 2** — Simulation & early hardware | 10% | April 18 | [Link](https://forms.office.com/Pages/ResponsePage.aspx?id=iLC0KX3SKUG5-YY3tZ6ks0CgaHBEKShAjtM5JlnmP3pUOU9CSUZBV0ZKUEtSVU1JQktHWkhLWEFPMC4u){.btn .btn-sm .btn-outline-primary}|
| **Final demonstration** | 30% | May 3 | |
| **Final technical report** | 50% | May 5 | |
| **Individual contribution & professionalism** | - | Ongoing | |

### Milestone 1: Project Definition and Modeling (10%)

Submit:

- Chosen project and team members
- Control objective
- Identified input, output, actuator, sensor, and main disturbance
- Initial mathematical model with assumptions
- Parts list and build plan

### Milestone 2: Simulation and Early Hardware Progress (10%)

Submit:

- Simulation model and controller design
- Plots showing system response
- Progress on hardware build
- Proof that sensing and actuation are working at a basic level

### Final Demonstration (30%)

You must:

- Give a live demo of the built system
- Show closed-loop operation
- Explain what works and what does not

### Final Technical Report (50%)

Your report should document the full project lifecycle — system modeling, control design, simulation, and implementation insights. Detailed guidelines and assessment criteria are on the dedicated page below.

[📄 View Report Guidelines & Assessment Criteria](project-report.qmd){.btn .btn-primary .btn-sm}

### Individual Contribution and Professionalism (10%)

Based on:

- Short individual reflection
- Peer evaluation
- Meeting deadlines
- Contribution during demo/presentation

---

::: {.callout-important appearance="minimal"}
### Remember
The resources above are **starting points**. Your final project must include your own **modeling, simulation, hardware implementation, and closed-loop control**. Use these references to understand the build process, then make the project your own.
:::
